events.verdict: Saraf (BKN) reaches forward to contest Santos' (GSW) shot attempt near the basket and makes contact to the ball. The contact with Santos' arm is marginal.
Wilson (BKN) backs into Porzingis (GSW) as he reaches for the ball, but the body contact is marginal.
Porzingis (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position during Wilson's (BKN) drive to the basket.
Although Johnson (BKN) makes contact to the ball, he makes illegal contact with Porzingis' (GSW) wrist and affects his jump shot attempt.
Melton (GSW) rests a hand on Sarad (BKN) during his drive to the basket and the contact is marginal.
Green (GSW) legally contests Saraf's (BKN) dunk attempt.
Wilson (BKN) briefly has an arm around Santos (GSW), which he immediately removes and does not affect his FOM.
Wilson (BKN) moves laterally into Melton (GSW), initiating body contact that affects his driving shot attempt. The illegal contact by Wilson precedes any contacy by Porzingis (GSW).
Melton (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position during Saraf's (BKN) drive to the basket and shot attempt near the rim.
Minott (BKN) commits a take foul on Green (GSW).
Payton II (GSW) is in a legal guarding position in Minott's (BKN) path when he throws the ball away.
